pill.desc: clear, colorless solution in a single-dose vial

clues.kinetics: Subcutaneous bioavailability is 37% in patients on dialysis, and apparent clearance is about 1.4 times faster in dialysis patients than in those not on dialysis.
clues.substance: Produced by recombinant DNA technology in Chinese hamster ovary cells, as a sterile, colorless, preservative-free solution of about 37,000 daltons.
clues.product: Approved under BLA 103951 as single-dose vials and prefilled syringes, given weekly or once every 2 weeks.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for death, heart attack, stroke, clots and tumor progression. Contraindicated in uncontrolled hypertension and pure red cell aplasia; hypertension and dyspnea are the most common reactions.
clues.indication: Treating anemia from chronic kidney disease in patients on or off dialysis, and anemia from the effects of concomitant myelosuppressive chemotherapy.
clues.mechanism: Stimulates red cell production by the same mechanism as the body's own erythropoietin.

tell: An erythropoiesis stimulator with a half-life about three times that of epoetin alfa when given intravenously.
